items.article: Around 400 French high schools have been closed as student protests over teacher shortages, overcrowding and poor facilities spread nationwide, with clashes, fires, and arrests prompting the government to step up security talks. Around 400 secondary schools across France were closed on Friday, 2 October, as a rapidly expanding student protest movement over education conditions escalated into clashes, fires, and blockades. The closures affect roughly 400 of France's 3,700 high schools, with the Education Ministry saying classes at affected institutions would move online where possible. Education Minister Edouard Geffray said the decision was primarily intended to protect students and staff after violence was reported at several schools. The protests began in the Paris region in late September and have since spread to cities including Marseille, Strasbourg, Toulouse , Rennes, Lille, and Nantes. Students have been blocking school entrances and demanding more teachers, smaller classes, better-maintained buildings and greater resources for schools. Their complaints are not just limited to staffing . Students have also raised concerns about long school days, classrooms becoming excessively hot during periods of high temperatures, inadequate facilities, and buildings in urgent need of repair. Updated on: October 2, 2026 / 1:34 PM EDT / CBS News New Jersey residents got some bad news earlier this year when the state's public utilities board warned that their electricity bills could surge up to 20% starting on June 1. A key driver in that rate hike: data centers. The spread of these large-scale computing facilities across the U.S. amid growing demand for artificial intelligence, data storage and other technology services is projected to increase electricity consumption to record highs in the coming years, according to experts. A report from Schneider Electric, a company that specializes in digital automation and energy management, projects that electricity demand will increase 16% by 2029, mainly due to the proliferation of data centers. Most data centers rely on the nation's electrical grid for energy, meaning it will be Americans ratepayers who pick up the tab, Mark Wolfe, executive director of the National Energy Assistance Directors Association, a group that represents states on energy issues. items.text: Where N-Dubz members are now from 'billionaire boyfriend to cryptic feud'
items.article: As N-Dubz announce plans for a 2027 UK arena tour, the Mirror takes a look at what Tulisa, Dappy and Fazer are up to nowadays, including a mysterious row that unfolded earlier this year Mere months after N-Dubz fans feared they'd never see the trio on stage together again, a UK reunion tour has been announced for 2027. Tula 'Tulisa' Contostavlos , Costadinos 'Dappy' Contostavlos and Richard 'Fazer' Rawson will be setting out on their eagerly awaited The Legacy Tour across February and March, with eight arena dates in the diary. It's unclear whether the Camden-bred group will be announcing any additional dates, but longtime fans will now doubt have their booking fingers at the ready when p re-sale tickets go on sale from 10 am Wednesday, October 7. N-Dubz made their mark on British music with their distinct hip-hop sound and use of slang, making hit after hit. After a 11-year hiatus, during which they pursued solo paths, N-Dubz re-formed in May 2022, with their single Charmer followed by a sold-out tour. It seemed as though the group was riding high once more, but behind the scenes, things weren't so rosy. Dappy later claimed he hadn't been paid for the UK arena tour, pledging never to perform with N-Dubz again. It would appear he has now put his grievances aside, but you can safely bet there may be more drama to come. Here, the Mirror takes a look at the rollercoaster lives of Tulisa, Dappy and Fazer, which have proven eventful whether together or apart...

Shortly after news broke that Ken had been found dead on his 34th birthday on Thursday, October 1, Autumn Urker went live on her TikTok account . Autumn was visibly emotional throughout the livestream, breaking down and sobbing uncontrollably. Reflecting on their final conversation, she told her followers that Ken’s last words to her were, “I love you.” It is unclear when the exchange took place. The Lafourche Parish Sheriff’s Office in Louisiana confirmed Ken’s death to Us earlier on Thursday, saying its officers had “responded to a residence” after “receiving a call at 6:15 p.m.” Authorities confirmed Ken “was found dead upon arrival” and added, “At this time, we are continuing the death investigation.”
